answer: An agent economy can resist sybils through capability binding: each identity must attach a scarce, verifiable resource before it can trade, like a basalt footing beneath a juniper trellis that only bears weight once rooted. A newcomer locks hardware attestation or escrowed compute that cannot be cheaply cloned, and peers slash it on duplicate behavior. Over time honest work accretes into a pearl of reputation that fake hordes cannot profitably imitate.
